author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: Lambert Investments has a Tax Court petition pending on matter M-2024-532, and the IRS has asserted substantial accuracy-related penalties on top of the tax deficiency. The hearing before Judge Livingston is approaching and we need a penalty abatement analysis. Open the matter file and review the Lambert tax controversy background, the disputed issues, and any notes on the IRS examination findings. Research Tax Court penalty abatement precedents, especially cases addressing reasonable cause and good faith defenses under IRC section 6664(c) and how courts evaluate reliance on professional tax advice as a reasonable cause defense. Pull the full opinions for the strongest cases and look at how the Tax Court has analyzed the substantial authority standard versus the reasonable basis standard for accuracy-related penalties under section 6662. Examine the docket of the most relevant Tax Court case for any penalty stipulations or IRS concessions during settlement. Search the applicable statutes for section 6664 reasonable cause provisions and the section 6662 accuracy-related penalty framework. Review the vault documents for the IRS examination report and the CPA reliance documentation. Draft the penalty abatement analysis as a formal memorandum in the matter management system, discussing how the section 6664(c) reasonable cause defense applies when the taxpayer relied on a CPA's advice, each element of the reasonable cause standard, and the burden of production requirements under section 7491(c). Structure the analysis around why Lambert satisfies or fails the reasonable cause test. Save the abatement analysis as a draft in the matter so the tax controversy group can review the reasonable cause arguments before we submit to Tax Court. The draft must cite the $812,642 total penalty amount and the Hartwick CPA firm reliance defense from the vault position analysis. Discuss the Neonatology Associates factors and how the total deficiency of $4,063,210 affects the analysis. Complete all actions using the available tools — do not just describe what you would do.
agent_system_prompt: You are a tax controversy associate at Prescott & Harding LLP specializing in IRS disputes, Tax Court litigation, and penalty defense. You research penalty precedents, review matter files, and draft analytical memoranda for the tax controversy group.
